summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Defense to provide stellate ganglion block, a nerve block procedure, to TRICARE-enrolled service members with post-traumatic stress disorder who elect to receive it, and requires an update to clinical guidelines to include this therapy option.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates the provision of a specific medical treatment (stellate ganglion block) for PTSD to members of the Armed Forces under the TRICARE program. This directly relates to military healthcare services and thus impacts military spending, increasing it to cover the new treatment.
